title: Internship- Full Stack Developer
description:
**INTERNSHIP\- Full Stack Developer**

**Company:** Pantelwar Private Limited

**Location:** Noida / Delhi NCR (on\-site)

**Experience:** Fresher/6 months intern

**Type:** Full\-time

**Duration:** 3\-6 months

About the role

We build AI\-native products — agents, RAG systems, workflow automation, and full\-stack applications — for fintech and capital markets clients. You'll own features end to end: schema to API to UI, shipped to production.

What you'll do

* Build and ship full\-stack features across Node.js backends and React/Next.js frontends.
* Design REST/GraphQL APIs, data models, and integrations with third\-party services.
* Write clean, typed, testable code and own it through review, deploy, and monitoring.
* Work directly with founders and clients to scope and de\-risk features quickly.
* Debug production issues across the stack — frontend, backend, database, infra.

Must\-haves

* Knowledge of building production web apps with **Node.js** and **React**.
* Solid **Next.js** (App Router, SSR/SSG, API routes) and **TypeScript**.
* Comfortable with relational databases (PostgreSQL) — schema design, queries, indexing.
* Understands REST/GraphQL, auth, and basic system design.
* Git, CI/CD, and a habit of shipping working software, not perfect plans.
* Go, Python, or a willingness to pick them up.
* Docker, basic cloud/infra (AWS/GCP), observability.

How we work

* Concrete over abstract. We optimize for shipping and measurable outcomes.
* You'll get real ownership early.
* Strong opinions welcome; back them with reasoning.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹18,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Work from home

Work Location: In person

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
**Location:** Noida  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 3\+ Years

About the Role

We are looking for a skilled **Full Stack Developer** with strong hands\-on experience in **Angular, Node.js, NestJS, Python, and MySQL**. The ideal candidate should also have basic knowledge of **AWS, Linux server environments, REST APIs, and software architecture**.

The candidate will be responsible for developing scalable web applications, designing and optimizing backend services and databases, supporting deployments, participating in technical discussions, and mentoring junior developers.

Key ResponsibilitiesFrontend Development

* Develop dynamic and responsive web applications using **Angular**.
* Build reusable components and frontend libraries.
* Integrate frontend applications with RESTful APIs.
* Implement authentication, authorization, and state management.
* Optimize application performance and UI/UX.

Backend Development

* Develop scalable backend services using **Node.js and NestJS**.
* Build REST APIs and microservices.
* Implement business logic using **Python** when required.
* Write clean, maintainable, and well\-documented code.
* Follow security and data protection best practices.
* Perform unit and integration testing.

Database Management

* Design, develop, and optimize **MySQL databases**.
* Write complex SQL queries and stored procedures.
* Handle indexing, data integrity, and performance tuning.
* Manage database migrations and backups.

Cloud \& DevOps

* Deploy and manage applications on **AWS**, including EC2, S3, and RDS.
* Work with **Linux\-based servers** such as Ubuntu/CentOS.
* Configure and manage development, testing, and production environments.
* Support CI/CD pipelines and automated deployments.
* Monitor application performance and troubleshoot production issues.

Architecture \& Leadership

* Participate in system architecture and technical design discussions.
* Conduct code reviews and maintain development standards.
* Mentor junior and mid\-level developers.
* Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other stakeholders.
* Prepare technical documentation and solution proposals.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* **3\+ years of full\-stack development experience.**
* Strong hands\-on experience with:
* **Angular**
* **Node.js \& NestJS**
* **Python backend development**
* **MySQL database design \& optimization**
* **AWS basics – deployment, hosting, and monitoring**
* **Linux server management**
* Good knowledge of **Git and version control workflows**.
* Strong understanding of **RESTful API design**.
* Knowledge of authentication mechanisms such as **JWT and OAuth**.
* Understanding of software architecture and design patterns.
* Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills.

Preferred / Nice to Have

* Experience with **Docker and containerization**.
* Familiarity with **microservices architecture**.
* Knowledge of **Redis/caching**.
* Experience with **Agile/Scrum methodologies**.
* Prior experience leading development teams.

Soft Skills

* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Ownership mindset and accountability.
* Ability to meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.

Key Skills

**Angular \| Node.js \| NestJS \| Python \| MySQL \| AWS \| Linux \| REST API \| Git \| JWT \| OAuth \| Docker \| Microservices**

Pay: ₹380,675\.71 \- ₹600,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
Senior Full Stack Developer \- Senior hands\-on engineering role covering frontend, backend, AWS cloud, DevOps, CI/CD, security, observability, and production ownership. Experience Role Core Focus 5–8 Years Senior Full Stack Developer AWS \+ DevOps \+ Full Stack.  
**Job Overview:**  
We are looking for an experienced Senior Full Stack Developer with 5–8 years of hands\-on experience designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining scalable web applications. The ideal candidate has strong frontend and backend expertise combined with practical AWS, DevOps, CI/CD, containerization, and cloud\-native deployment experience. The role requires close collaboration with product, architecture, QA, security, DevOps, and engineering teams to deliver secure, reliable, maintainable, and high\-performing systems. Key Responsibilities **Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable full\-stack web applications.**  Build responsive frontend applications using React.js, Angular, Next.js, or similar technologies. **Apply strong debugging, problem\-solving, edge\-case handling, ESLint, coding standards, and best practices.**  Develop robust backend services and RESTful APIs using Node.js, NestJS, or similar technologies. **Design REST APIs, microservices, third\-party integrations, authentication, and authorization.**  Work with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB, or equivalent databases; optimize queries and data access. **Design, deploy, and manage secure AWS environments using EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, ECS/EKS, DynamoDB, API Gateway, IAM, VPC, and CloudWatch.**  Build CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, AWS CodePipeline, or equivalent tools. **Containerize applications with Docker and manage workloads using Kubernetes/EKS or ECS.**  Implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar tools. **Automate builds, deployments, monitoring, alerting, and operational processes.**  Troubleshoot production issues, perform root\-cause analysis, and drive reliable resolutions. **Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, technical design, and mentoring.**  Guide and mentor developers in building production\-grade applications, ensuring best practices for scalability, reliability, security, performance, and maintainability in real\-world production environments. **Collaborate across teams and work effectively in an Agile/Scrum environment. Required Technical Skills Frontend JavaScript / TypeScript**  React.js / Angular / Next.js **HTML5**  CSS3 **MUI**  Responsive UI **State management Backend Node.js / NestJS**  RESTful APIs **Microservices**  Authentication / Authorization **Third\-party integrations Databases PostgreSQL / MySQL**  MongoDB / DynamoDB **Schema design**  Indexing **Query optimization**  Performance tuning AWS EC2 **S3**  RDS **Lambda**  ECS / EKS **DynamoDB**  API Gateway **IAM**  VPC **CloudWatch**  Load Balancers **Auto Scaling DevOps CI/CD**  Jenkins / GitHub Actions / GitLab CI/CD / AWS CodePipeline **Docker**  Kubernetes **Terraform / CloudFormation**  Git Operations Linux/Unix **Scripting**  Logging **Monitoring**  Alerting **Production support**  Incident response **RCA Preferred Skills**  Microservices and cloud\-native architecture; AWS Well\-Architected Framework. **Serverless and event\-driven architecture.**  Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis, or similar messaging/caching technologies. **IAM, secrets management, encryption, network security, and secure application design. JOB DESCRIPTION Senior Full Stack Developer – AWS \& DevOps 5–8 Years Experience** . Automated testing / TDD, performance optimization, scalability, and capacity planning.

**Qualifications:**  
**Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field.**  5–8 years of professional software development experience. **Strong hands\-on experience across frontend and backend development.**  Proven experience deploying and supporting production applications on AWS. **Strong understanding of DevOps, CI/CD, cloud security, scalability, and production operations.**  Excellent communication, collaboration, problem\-solving, and technical leadership skills.  
**Ideal Candidate :**  
A hands\-on Senior Full Stack Developer who can own the complete application lifecycle—from UI and API development through AWS deployment, CI/CD, monitoring, troubleshooting, and production support. The candidate should guide developers, contribute to architecture decisions, and consistently deliver production\-grade systems with strong standards for scalability, reliability, security, performance, and maintainability.  
**Core Competency Snapshot Area**  
Expected Capability Full Stack Frontend \+ backend ownership and modern application development AWS / Cloud Secure deployment, networking, scalability, availability, and operations DevOps CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes/EKS or ECS, IaC, automation Architecture REST, microservices, cloud\-native, event\-driven, resilient systems Data Relational \+ NoSQL design, indexing, optimization, performance Security IAM, authentication, authorization, secrets, encryption, network security Leadership Code reviews, mentoring, architecture input, cross\-team collaboration This role combines senior full\-stack engineering with AWS cloud architecture, DevOps automation, and end\-to\-end production ownership.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹70,000\.00 per month

title: Senior Fullstack Developer
description:
**About Our Company**


Ameriprise India LLP has been providing client based financial solutions to help clients plan and achieve their financial objectives for 20 years. We are part of Ameriprise Financial Inc., a US financial planning company headquartered in Minneapolis with a global presence and diversified financial services leader with more than $1\.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year\-end 2024\. The firm’s focus areas include Asset Management and Advice, Retirement Planning and Insurance Protection.


Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture that rewards you for your contributions, and work with other talented individuals who share your passion for doing great work. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to make your mark at the office and a difference in your community. So, if you're talented, driven and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares, take the next step and create a career at Ameriprise India LLP.

**Job Description**


Responsible for Designing, Coding, Testing, Implementing, Maintaining and Supporting Vantage\-One based application that is delivered within scope, with high quality, on time and within budget.
  

  

Work closely with Business partners, \& Technology team members to understand business requirements, perform analysis and design of quality technical solutions that comply with the organization's architectural standards. Provide technical guidance to the development team through the full software life cycle.
This role for an experienced full\-stack engineer to provide people engineering SME and support to our business partners in the Asset Management. The candidate should be hands on in advanced programing, visualization, analytical models and algorithms. The candidate should demonstrate strong technical/problem solving skills, manage multiple projects collaboratively and ensure adherence to enterprise standards. You’ll work with smart, talented people across our business to create innovative, next\-generation cloud\-based applications, and analytics/models. You’ll be involved, hands\-on, through the entire development cycle. And you’ll redefine the way our traders, portfolio managers and analysts support our clients.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and build the next generation of the world's best investment management technology platform, focusing on managing various investment lifecycle processes and investment research.
* Lead and mentor a team of software developers, providing guidance and support throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Solve complex problems; research and bring in new and advanced machine learning concepts; takes a new perspective using existing solutions.
* Provides input on tool and technology selection, standards and shares evolving best practices.
* Participates in discovery sessions to identify opportunities to leverage analytics to automate and enhance business processes.
* Operate independently in a product centric culture with sense of ownership and accountability.
* Refine business and functional requirements and translate them into scalable technical designs.
* Collaborate with product engineering teams to implement comprehensive AI/ML\-based solutions from start to finish.
* Apply quality software engineering practices throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Optimize the software delivery and workflow of the team.·
* Work with team members in a multi\-office, multi\-country environment.

**Required Qualifications**

* B.S./M.S. degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related subject area with 4\+ years, or equivalent experience
* Strong hands\-on experience with:
* Python (FastAPI, Flask, or Django)
* React.js
* SQL (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL)
* AWS (EC2, Lambda, S3, RDS, API Gateway)
* Experience with REST APIs, Git, CI/CD, and Agile methodologies.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.
* Should have excellent communication skills, should be able to interact with business system analysts and get clear understanding of requirements.

**In\-Office Collaboration**


We are a client\-centric, relationship\-based business. Working together, in\-person, is foundational to how we achieve results. By fostering a culture of face\-to\-face collaboration, idea sharing, productivity and personal connection, we deliver for our stakeholders — clients, advisors, employees and shareholders. Our employees work in the office at least three (3\) days per week, with flexibility to work from home two (2\) days per week. Some roles may require additional in\-office time or different in\-office expectations, and specific requirements will be discussed during the hiring process.

**Full\-Time/Part\-Time**


Full time**Timings**
